_comment: Upstream checkouts under $RV_THIRD_PARTY at these commits (scripts/setup.sh clones them, scripts/check_env.sh verifies them). They are never edited: this repository adds its code on top through editable installs.

OSWorld-V2.used_for: OSWorld 2.0 tasks, evaluators, Docker provider and the official DSH runner (run_case); its venv also runs WeaveBench and the tests
OSWorld-V2.local_additions: gated task classes evaluation_examples/task_class/task_*.py (scripts/tools/download_osworld_v2_tasks.py, gitignored upstream)

WeaveBench.used_for: task setup, warmup, deliverable archive and the OpenClaw agent-as-judge (installed editable into the OSWorld-V2 venv)

agents-last-exam.used_for: ALE v1.1 tasks (start / evaluate) and the QEMU provider, in its own venv
agents-last-exam.local_additions: secret/eval_time/openai.env (ALE's grading model and key, gitignored upstream)
